the model-based reinforcement learning (RL), but not model-free RL, is positively correlated with generalization in the relational memory task, acquired equivalence.

the nature of the multiple memory systems, and how these systems support different forms of learning and decision-making.
the relationship between the multiple memory systems and multiple decision systems.
the relationship between memory and decision making.

there is no evidence for a direct relationship between model-free and model-based decision systems.

the model-based RL system, like acquired equivalence and other forms of relational memory, is a hippocampally-dependent system that relies on a representation of the environment, and that the model-based system is distinct from the model-free system, which is not hippocampus-dependent and is not reliant on a representation of environmental contingencies.

model-based RL is not a single process, but rather a set of processes that can vary in their reliance on a general-purpose relational memory.
